items.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
items.description: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity.
